notes.title: Earth Campaign and Earth Map Visual Addition
notes.content: Districts in Earth Campaign use yellow to represent alien territories in Tiny Pod Rescue game. A shapi shape is now represented on the left side of the district. And a vertical line on the right side, for the game Bridge The Pods. These visuals turn blue when these games are completed successfully in that district.

notes.title: Earth Map and Earth Campaign now show progress with Shapi and Bridge
notes.content:
A district is freed of aliens when the 3 games Tiny Pods Rescue, Shapi, Bridge The Pods are completed.
The Earth Map and Earth Campaign use color yellow for districts under alien control. They use blue color for districts under human control.

NEW - these maps now figure a blue square if Shapi was completed for that district. And another blue square if Bridge The Pods was completed.

notes.title: Bridge The Pods - new version
notes.content:
Mini game Bridge The Pods has evolved.
[list]
[*] Player can select tiles to rotate from a convenient 2x2 square to a much larger selection - on every district
[*] Easy districts have more black tiles - from which to build a bridge from. Harder districts have the minimal amount of black tiles to bridge two sides of the board.
[/list]

This evolution was derived from months of playing the game and retain what we found most engaging and fun to solve.

notes.title: Start Screen - simpler way to start the games
notes.content:
To start Shapi, you can now press X button on game controller
To start Bridge The Pods, press A button on game controller
And you can continue to play Tiny Pods Rescue with B button on game controller

notes.title: Start Screen with new high resolution background images
notes.content:
Start Screen is now using high resolution images
Previously highly pixelated images were a reference to nostalgia 1980's video game graphics.
When toggling Y game pad button to Turn-Base mode, characters will show up in previous highly pixelated images. Because really we can't help missing this era, even if high res images are also so great at animating the story around Tiny Pods Rescue / Shapi / Bridge the Pods apocalyptic setup.

No game logic was altered in this release

notes.title: Startup page includes district previews
notes.content:
When navigating through Earth Campaign districts, any district or previously played districts, you will now see a preview of the corresponding Tiny Pods Rescue board, Shapi board, Bridge the Pods board.
This makes it easy to pick the district and game you wish to play.

notes.title: District Preview
notes.content: Start Screen now includes a rendering of the board games for the selected district. So you can quickly see what the Tiny Pods rescue board, Shapi board and Bridge the Pods board look like.

notes.title: Startup screen has new player stat : Shapi Mars
notes.content: Startup Screen now shows the number of Shapi districts you have completed from the Mars Campaign, including the total number of moves it took.

notes.title: Mars Campaign now contains 27 Shapi levels and 6 Tiny Pods Rescue levels
notes.content:
Reminder: you can play Mars Campaign by pressing numeric key 5 (for Shapi) or numeric key 4 (for Tiny Pods Rescue) from Start Screen. This gets you to play from the beginning, from district 0.

You can also play any district from Mars Campaign in any order, E.g. to play a recently added district 25 (or 26, or 27), go to Start Screen / District Code and set the 9 digits to 000 000 025 and press numeric key 6 to start Shapi on this hand-picked district.

notes.title: Mars Campaign for Tiny Pods Rescue
notes.content:
From Start Screen press 4 (num key 4) to play Mars Campaign districts for Tiny Pods Rescue.

Mars Campaign contains 3 districts manually created. This differentiates it from the game play provided by Earth Campaigns. Each Earth Campaign contains 9 districts randomly generated.

notes.title: 22 Shapi levels
notes.content:
Shapi Mars Campaign now includes 22 levels.

To play the Shapi Mars Campaign, press 4 (num key 4) on your keyboard, from the Start Screen.

You can also play individual levels of the Shapi Mars Campaign. Pick a district between 000 000 000 and 000 000 021 on the Vault on Start Screen. And press 6 (num key 6) on your keyboard to start this district in Shapi.

notes.title: Shapi - Mars Campaign now has 17 levels
notes.content:
On Start Screen, press key 4 on your keyboard (numeric 4). This will start the Mars Campaign for the Shapi game.
We have added new levels for the Mars Campaign, from District 0 to District 16.

notes.title: Quick Play and other game modes added
notes.content:
On Start Screen, the character mode now shows
[olist]
[*] Character stats for Tiny Pods Rescue, Bridge and Shapi games
[*] New ways to launch these 3 games, using the keyboard number keys 1 2 3 etc. (details below) : [b]Quick Play, Current District, Mars Campaign[/b]
[/olist]

[b]Quick Play[/b] lets you start a new game to just have instant fun. It picks a random district so your game will always be varied. It is available for all three games

[b]Current District[/b] is the traditional way to play. It starts the game you want against the selected district in the Earth Campaign, Vault or History. So you can improve your score and/or progress in your Earth Campaign.

[b]Mars Campaign[/b] is available for Shapi game. Play the 14 districts (including the tutorial districts) in sequence which form the Mars Campaign. These levels were crafted manually by the Author of the game, Christophe Cornu.

notes.title: Mini game Shapi can be played against 14 manually crafted levels (district 0)
notes.content:
Mini game Shapi can be played against 14 manually crafted levels (district 0)
Or it can be played against randomly generated levels (pick any district from Earth Campaign or Vault on start screen)

notes.title: Release of a second minigame Shapi
notes.content:
From start screen, press 2 to play minigame Shapi

Like Tiny Pods Rescue and minigame Bridge the pods, Shapi is a 2D board game, with a distinct set of rules and controls.

The important part is to move and evolve your shape without breaking it apart. And on advanced levels, this is not trivial, making Shapi a very unique puzzle.

notes.title: Minigame Bridge The Pods defaults to random district
notes.content:
Press 1 from Start Screen to quickly play the minigame Bridge The Pods

It will start on a random district.

You can also select a specific district in Earth Campaign / History / Vault. Then press 1. Minigame will use that district code to generate the same board each time. This allows you to play the same board and try improving your score.

notes.title: Minigame "Bridge the pods" full release / no longer experimental
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Minigame "Bridge the pods" can be played against any district
[*] Try to resolve each level in the lowest amount of moves.
[*] High score is now displayed while playing the minigame
[/list]

Before rescuing pods in a given district, the resistance needed to hack the alien system controlling that district. Splitting the tiles of the alien system is what the minigame "Bridge the pods" is about.

Note you can play Tiny Pods Rescue or the mini game in the order that you wish.

notes.title: Minigame Bridge The Pods - improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Can rotate selection clockwise and counter clockwise with B and A buttons on controller
[*] Move count understands 4 rotations at same location changes nothing - and does not count it. This lets you try things out and change your mind
[*] Move count understands 3 clockwise rotations are identical to 1 counter clockwise rotation - and therefore only counts as 1. So you can freely use the B and/or A buttons and still get the best move count
[/list]

Reminder: minigame Bridge The Pods is accessible from the Start Screen - press key "1" on your keyboard.

notes.title: Early Access - mini game Bridge The Pods
notes.content:
On start screen, press 1 to start a mini game.
Try to align the black tiles to cross the board horizontally or vertically.
You can only position black tiles by rotating a square on the board.
At each level, the square gets bigger and bigger. It becomes less and less intuitive to cross the board.

What level can you achieve?

Note. This is early access. This mini-game does not currently save your score.

notes.title: Freed sectors in districts now prominently visualized on Start Screen
notes.content: When you remove all pawns from a sector of a district, that sector is freed. The start screen / Earth Campaign now shows those sectors with a blue border.

notes.title: Bug fix - earth campaign and campaign map
notes.content: Bug fix - earth campaign view and campaign map are not updated after completing a level

notes.title: Character, campaign and turn mode are now remembered
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] When game is started, it now remembers which character, campaign and turn mode you last played.
[*] When selecting a district under the Start Screen / Campaign, user is reminded they can explore and pick a different campaign with the X button.
[/olist]

Note a Campaign is a set of 9 districts with distinct attributes (quantity of ennemies and pods). When you rescue up to 80% of the pods in these 9 districts, you receive an Earth Medal.

There are 100 campaigns, accessible from the Start Screen / press and hold the X button. Then use the analog stick / digital pad to pick a different campaign.

Campaigns are stored per character and per turn mode (real time or turn based). So choose your favourite character and turn mode, and rescue all the pods in these districts!

notes.title: Start game in full screen, not window mode
notes.content: Correct Config.txt window attribute to false instead of true

notes.title: Early access - campaign map and selector
notes.content:
On Start Screen,  click X Blue Button on controller to bring up a campaign map. This shows the 100 campaigns available. Keep X Blue Button pressed and then use game pad arrows to pick a different campaign. Release X. That campaign has now been selected.

This is very early and primitive campaign map. Selected campaign is not yet persisted after ending game. There are glitches where campaign map is not properly refreshed.

notes.title: Crash fix / Editor mode polish
notes.content:
Crash fix when viewing recently played levels in Editor mode
More polish for Editor mode

notes.title: Game Editor has matured and is no longer in Early Access
notes.content:
[list]
[*] You can now replay districts received from friends & other players (via the Recent Battles section of Start Screen)
[*] Scores and stats now also work for custom districts created by a game editor
[/list]

The Game Editor remains a basic no-frills editor. And the clipboard CTR-C / CTRL-V remains the mechanism by which to export and import districts made with the editor. But that is enough to open up a wide range of fun districts to dream up and offer new challenges to Tiny Pods Rescue players. You can exchange those strings representing a district through your communication channel of your choice - steam forum etc.

notes.title: District Editor improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Bug fix - district played from clipboard has wrong number of sectors
[*] District Editor UI improvements - start screen has new large icon and description of District Editor mode
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access: District Editor & Play Custom District from Clipboard
notes.content:
"District Editor" lets you create and share your own districts with other Steam players.
In this early access, you can create your district, which then gets copied to your PC's clipboard when you leave the editor.

Here's an example below.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195570/0c054ec1668da828841057b13fae03b63288e4cf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195570/94bbd53f48f8e88a28cb7a8ce50c9fdd343be04e.png[/img][/url]

[noparse]Tiny Pods Rescue - 2D Board Game Edition,DISTRICT_MAP,H4sIAAAAAAAACjPUMTAygAAdczMdYzMdD/oCvwA4xAWGjkL8Ph2caoZCuI5GwGgE0DAHgEGBXwEUgTGMhFFwGsFAYiEzsQujGYNkBdRGoAOQEjx1fUgfNXjBqJrR8CEpbXiPJqDRzANPHBF4AXXV0A0AALFuM7p9CwAA,7E9DAE723745FE2A5C331B138D89A23DEC34B05A60E8E18E322838811EBBDAF0,https://store.steampowered.com/app/3148200[/noparse]

The above string represents a district created with the District Editor. It is a level for beginners to practice rescuing 100% of the pods. How do you play it?

[olist]
[*] Select the above string in its entirety and CTRL-C to copy it to your PC's clipboard
[*] Start the game Tiny Pods Rescue, from Steam (you must be connected to Steam)
[*] Select your favorite character and press your gamepad right bumper button
[/olist]

And that's it. You are now playing a district created by someone else!

This feature is marked as Early Access. The editor is basic. Scores for levels played from the clipboard are not stored. You need to store those strings with your own favourite text editor if you want to replay them later / not lose them.

notes.title: Turn Based mode - visual cue added for current player
notes.content: Turn Based mode - during the game, it is now very clear when you can play or when you must wait for the CPU or other human players. Bottom of screen contains a cue related to the player's selection color and their side (left or right - human or alien side)

notes.title: New Turn Based mode
notes.content:
[b]New Feature "Turn Based 20"[/b]

On Start Screen (top right), you can toggle between the existing default Real Time mode and the new Turn Based 20 mode.

In Real Time mode, you and ennemy commanders can issue commands in parallel.
In Turn Based 20 mode, each commander must wait for their turn. After 20 commands at most, the game ends and whoever has the most pods is the winner. This forces you to be a bit more strategic with less focus on speed of executing commands. It brings renewed interest in the most advanced commands (the ones with a defined target area that automatically turn your pawns hot in a single command)

A second leaderboard has been created for this new way of playing. Your stats are managed separately for each mode.

If you loved the game as it was, just stick to the default Real Time mode. Nothing has changed there!
